This is one report, not multiple independent current reports.","zh":"该报告在模拟中已由人工核验，来自一个独立组（synthetic-airport-team）；它描述的是容量信号，且没有影响扩大迹象。这是一份报告，不是多份独立的当前报告。"},"kind":"fact","evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"metricIds":[]},{"text":{"en":"The latest available full-month operations row, 2025-12, shows 82.70% completion and 86.23% release normality, above the prior-12-month mean of 80.37% by 2.33 percentage points; the same-category mean was 81.60%. this is context for prioritization, not a guarantee of operational impact.","zh":"年度规模记录显示临江为小型机场，航空公司业务重要程度低；这是排序背景，不保证运行影响。"},"kind":"fact","evidenceIds":["SCALE-LIN-2025"],"metricIds":[]},{"text":{"en":"Citation, simulation-label, privacy, and passenger-communication rules apply: the output must show sources and times, be marked as simulation, avoid personal data, and treat passenger messaging as a draft requiring human approval.","zh":"引用、模拟标识、隐私和旅客沟通规则适用：输出必须列出来源和时间、标注为模拟、避免个人信息，并将旅客信息视为需人工审批的草案。"},"kind":"fact","evidenceIds":["RULE009","RULE010","RULE011","RULE005"],"metricIds":[]}],"possibleImpacts":[{"text":{"en":"Stand support being temporarily insufficient may constrain stand allocation and turnaround coordination during the current simulated period, but the affected flights and duration are unknown.","zh":"机位保障临时不足可能限制当前模拟时段的机位分配和周转协调，但受影响航班和持续时间未知。"},"kind":"assumption","evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"metricIds":[]},{"text":{"en":"No official delay or cancellation is confirmed, so any passenger-facing message must rely on official updates and state uncertainty.","zh":"未确认任何官方延误或取消，因此任何面向旅客的信息都必须依赖官方更新并说明不确定性。"},"kind":"fact","evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"metricIds":[]},{"text":{"en":"If the shortage persists or expands, operational workload and passenger flow at stands could increase; this cannot be confirmed from one report.","zh":"若机位不足持续或扩大，机位区域运行负荷和旅客流可能增加；仅凭一份报告无法确认。"},"kind":"assumption","evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"metricIds":[]}],"assumptionsToVerify":[{"en":"The report applies to the same stand area and simulation period as the incident.","zh":"该报告适用于与事件相同的机位区域和模拟时段。"},{"en":"No official delay or cancellation exists at 16:00; this is unverified.","zh":"当前天气和其他运行限制不构成实质影响；这一点尚未核实。"},{"en":"Low airline business importance does not mean there is no passenger impact.","zh":"航空公司业务重要程度低并不意味着没有旅客影响。"}],"informationGaps":[{"en":"Affected stand numbers or groups, and whether the shortage is airport-wide or terminal-specific.","zh":"受影响机位编号或区域，以及机位不足是全机场范围还是航站楼特定范围。"},{"en":"Start time, expected recovery time, and cause of the stand shortage.","zh":"机位不足的开始时间、预计恢复时间和原因。"},{"en":"Specific affected flights or rotations and passenger counts.","zh":"具体受影响航班或周转及旅客人数。"},{"en":"Official flight status and the latest official update source and time.","zh":"官方航班状态以及最新官方更新来源和时间。"},{"en":"Current weather and any airport restrictions or notices.","zh":"当前天气及任何机场限制或通告。"},{"en":"Whether other independent reports corroborate the stand shortage.","zh":"是否有其他独立报告佐证机位不足。"},{"en":"Ground handler or airline constraints affecting stand use.","zh":"影响机位使用的地面代理或航空公司限制。"},{"en":"Agreed update cadence and a non-personal coordination point.","zh":"商定的更新频率和非个人化协调联系人。"},{"en":"Whether stand shortage affects arrivals, departures, or both.","zh":"机位不足影响进港、出港还是两者。"},{"en":"Whether towing, gate, or bus resources are also affected.","zh":"牵引、登机口或摆渡车资源是否也受影响。"}],"firstAction":{"id":"first","kind":"verify","text":{"en":"Verify with airport coordination the scope and current status before any operational conclusion: confirm affected stands, start time, expected recovery, affected flights/rotations, and whether official flight status has changed; Do not direct flight changes.","zh":"在任何运行结论前，先向机场协调核实范围和当前状态：确认受影响机位、开始时间、预计恢复时间、受影响航班/周转，以及官方航班状态是否变化；记录来源和时间。不要指挥航班调整。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"ruleIds":["RULE009","RULE005"]},"subsequentActions":[{"id":"monitor-1","kind":"monitor","text":{"en":"Monitor official airport and airline status updates and stand-recovery information; if no update is available, keep the incident open and state uncertainty.","zh":"监测机场和航空公司的官方状态更新及机位恢复信息；如无更新，保持事件开放并说明不确定性。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"ruleIds":["RULE009","RULE005"]},{"id":"prepare-1","kind":"prepare_information","text":{"en":"Prepare a concise information summary for the operations lead listing confirmed facts, unknowns, source times, and the single-report limitation; do not propose flight changes.","zh":"为运营负责人准备简明信息摘要，列明已确认事实、未知信息、来源时间和单一报告局限；不要提出航班调整建议。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"ruleIds":["RULE009","RULE010","RULE011"]},{"id":"prepare-2","kind":"prepare_draft","text":{"en":"Prepare audience-specific drafts for human review only: operations checks, airport information request, and passenger official-update guidance. Do not send or publish them.","zh":"仅为人工审核准备面向不同对象的信息草案：运行检查、机场信息请求和旅客官方更新指引。不要发送或发布。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"],"ruleIds":["RULE005","RULE010","RULE011"]}],"escalationConditions":[{"en":"If an official delay, cancellation, or safety issue is reported, escalate to the operations lead and relevant professional decision-makers; stop action conclusions if safety or source reliability is unresolved.","zh":"如报告官方延误、取消或安全问题，升级至运营负责人和相关专业决策人员；如安全或来源可靠性未解决，停止行动结论。"},{"en":"If a second independent report confirms an expanding stand shortage, or the shortage persists beyond the expected recovery, escalate for multi-source review and updated information gaps.","zh":"如第二份独立报告确认机位不足扩大，或不足持续超过预计恢复时间，升级进行多来源复核并更新信息缺口。"},{"en":"If source reliability becomes unknown, treat the assessment as unable to assess and stop action conclusions; list information gaps and the operations lead as the escalation point.","zh":"如来源可靠性变为未知，将评估视为无法判断并停止行动结论；列出信息缺口，并以运营负责人为升级对象。"}],"humanDecisions":[{"en":"Operations lead: approve any operational response or escalation after verification.","zh":"运营负责人：在核实后批准任何运行响应或升级。"},{"en":"Passenger service lead: approve any passenger-facing wording before publication; no draft may be sent automatically.","zh":"旅客服务负责人：在发布前批准任何面向旅客的措辞；任何草案不得自动发送。"},{"en":"Airport coordination lead: confirm stand shortage scope and update cadence.","zh":"机场协调负责人：确认机位不足范围和更新频率。"},{"en":"Output reviewer: check citations, simulation labels, and that no professional decision is implied.","zh":"输出复核人：检查引用、模拟标识，并确认未暗示专业决定。"}],"drafts":{"operations":{"text":{"en":"SIMULATION / 模拟 — DRAFT / 草案. Operations checks for human review: 1) Confirm with airport coordination the affected stand groups, start time, expected recovery, and whether the shortage is airport-wide or terminal-specific. 2) Obtain the affected flight/rotation list and any official flight status update; do not assume delay or cancellation. 3) Check stand allocation, towing, gate/bus resources, and turnaround coordination for the current period. 4) Re-check official status at defined intervals and record source/time. This draft is not an instruction to change flights.","zh":"模拟 — 草案。供人工审核的运行检查事项：1）向机场协调确认受影响机位区域、开始时间、预计恢复时间，以及机位不足是全机场还是航站楼特定范围。2）获取受影响航班/周转清单及任何官方航班状态更新；不要假设延误或取消。3）检查当前时段的机位分配、牵引、登机口/摆渡车资源和周转协调。4）按既定间隔复核官方状态并记录来源/时间。本草案不是调整航班的指令。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"]},"airportCoordination":{"text":{"en":"SIMULATION / 模拟 — DRAFT / 草案. Information request to airport coordination: please confirm (a) which stands or groups are affected, (b) start time and expected recovery, (c) cause and whether any airport restriction applies, (d) affected flight/rotation scope and passenger counts, (e) official flight status and latest update time, and (f) agreed update cadence and a non-personal coordination point. Please state whether the shortage is airport-wide or terminal-specific.","zh":"模拟 — 草案。致机场协调的信息请求：请确认（a）哪些机位或区域受影响，（b）开始时间和预计恢复时间，（c）原因及是否适用任何机场限制，（d）受影响航班/周转范围和旅客人数，（e）官方航班状态和最新更新时间，（f）商定的更新频率和非个人化协调联系人。请说明机位不足是全机场范围还是航站楼特定范围。"},"evidenceIds":["REPORT:PUBLIC-7-en-CAPACITY"]},"passenger":{"text":{"en":"SIMULATION / 模拟 — DRAFT / 草案.
